{{Quote|This weapon was developed at a research facility here on Naboo.''"<br />"''Then that's our next target.|[[Col Serra]] and a Renegade Squadron soldier|<ref name="TotC-LS" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''mission''' was carried out by [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Renegades assaulted an Imperial [[Naboo weapons depot|weapons depot]] and found data concerning the new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']]. They later attacked the [[Imperial Weapon Research Facility|research facility]] where the superlaser for the ''Conqueror'' had been developed and learned more about the Star Destroyer.<ref name="TotC-LS" />
